day_summary: STOP EXECUTED — FULL EXIT CONFIRMED. Day 2 of the stop clock resolved as predicted: BTC closed the June 24 UTC midnight candle at approximately $62,729 — well below the $63,500 stop trigger. Stop executed per framework: FULL EXIT required, no exceptions. The intraday high during the regular US session reached only $63,239 (Crypto.com exchange 24h data), still $261 below the $63,500 trigger — Micron Q3's massive AH beat pushed the session high but was insufficient to reset the clock. After the UTC midnight close, BTC accelerated lower: selling to an AH low of $59,105 before recovering to ~$60,770 as of 01:04 UTC June 25. The post-stop deterioration confirms the structural breakdown thesis. Three Day-1 triggers in six sessions + double-bottom breach + stop execution + post-stop dump = STRUCTURAL REGIME CHANGE confirmed. Re-entry framework: two consecutive UTC daily closes ABOVE $62,000 from within the $59,000–$62,000 zone required before any re-entry consideration.

analysis:
## Technical analysis

**Trend:** BTC confirmed a structural breakdown on June 24 with stop execution at the UTC midnight close (~$62,729). Post-stop dump to $59,105 (AH low) accelerated the decline. Currently $60,770 at 01:04 UTC June 25. All major moving averages overhead and bearish.

**The Stop Clock Resolution:** The June 24 24h high of $63,239 was reached at approximately 20:30–21:00 UTC on the Micron AH beat — still $261 short of the $63,500 reset trigger. The failure to reach the trigger on the most powerful risk-on catalyst of the session is the most bearish technical signal possible: even maximum risk-on was insufficient.

**Post-stop structure:** $59,000–$62,000 is the new structural trading range. The $59,105 AH low is the first test. Two consecutive closes above $62,000 from within this range is the re-entry gate. Until then, the framework remains FLAT/CASH on BTC.

**Re-entry framework:** (1) Watch for two consecutive UTC daily closes above $62,000; (2) Monitor IBIT flows daily for institutional re-engagement; (3) Cold PCE is a necessary catalyst but not sufficient alone; (4) Do not chase any single-session bounce above $62,000 — two closes are required.
